query:
Institutional entrepreneurs: refers to those who not only perform the functions of traditional entrepreneurs, but also help establish a market system in the process of their career development. They are highly sensitive to opportunities in the development environment and dare to break through institutional barriers to obtain considerable income.

An entrepreneur who innovated the mode of instant messaging to change the way people transmit information is not an institutional entrepreneur according to the above definition.
